title: Core: AS2 MovieClip built-in methods (attachMovie, createEmptyMovieClip, gotoAndPlay)
description: Test compilation of MovieClip method calls: mc.attachMovie('id',name,depth), mc.createEmptyMovieClip(name,depth), mc.gotoAndPlay(n), mc.gotoAndStop(n), mc.play(), mc.stop(), mc.nextFrame(), mc.prevFrame(), mc.removeMovieClip(), mc._x, mc._y, mc._width, mc._height, mc._xscale, mc._yscale, mc._alpha, mc._visible, mc._rotation. Each should emit ActionCallMethod (0x52) or ActionGetMember (0x4f) + ActionSetMember (0x4e) appropriately.
